name: dark-factory
description: Spec-driven development pipeline for coding agents: lanes, playbooks, budgeted dispatch, and multi-model review

interface.shortDescription: Lanes, playbooks, and budgeted dispatch for routed development work
interface.longDescription: Dark Factory routes development work through a spec-driven pipeline: classify the ask into a lane, run the matching playbook, reserve every dispatch against a run budget, and close with multi-model review and QA acceptance. Entry is explicit; the router never activates itself.
defaultPrompt: Route this work through a df lane and playbook.
Run a df code review on the current branch.
Interview me for a PRD on this feature.
